content: To do injustice is far more shameful and destructive to the soul than to suffer it.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: If someone cheats you, steals your wallet, or slanders your name, your body or wallet suffers, but your inner soul remains intact. But the moment you cheat, lie, or oppress another human being, you inflict a mortal wound upon your own moral character. Guard your integrity at all costs.
practicalInsight: Never retaliate with dishonest or shady tactics when someone mistreats you. Preserve the purity of your own soul.
reflectionPrompt: Have you ever rationalized unethical behavior with the excuse that 'they did it first'?
